changelog:
v2.28.0 背诵页关联词跳转 + 高考考点全面扩充

【背诵页关联词跳转】
- 词条详情弹窗移至全局，背诵页点击关联词/易混词可直接跳转查看详情
- 不再局限于词库页才能查看单词完整考点

【高考考点全面扩充】
- 新增49个高考高频动词的详细考点数据（共189个词条）
- 重点覆盖高考核心语法考点：
  · to do vs doing 搭配：forget/remember/stop/try/mean/regret/continue等
  · 只接doing的动词：enjoy/finish/avoid/mind/suggest/admit/deny/risk等
  · 只接to do的动词：refuse/promise/pretend/happen/seem/offer等
  · 介词搭配（to为介词）：look forward to/get down to/devote...to/be used to doing
  · 使役动词：make/let/have sb do vs get sb to do
  · 虚拟语气：suggest/demand/insist that + (should) do
  · it句型：It takes sb time to do / It turns out that / I would appreciate it if
  · 双宾语结构：offer/give/tell sb sth
  · 情态动词+have done：needn't have done / didn't need to do
  · wish虚拟语气：wish + 过去时/过去完成时
devNotes: move detailItem modal from inside library section to global scope so it renders on all pages including memorization/study page; add 49 high-frequency gaokao verb entries to wordEnrichment.js with examPoints covering to-do/doing patterns, preposition collocations (to as preposition), causative verbs (make/let/have sb do), subjunctive mood (suggest/demand/insist + should do), it patterns (It takes...to do / It turns out that), double object constructions, and modal+have done patterns; total enrichment entries now 189 words
